import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:]))
    
    b = []
    for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
        b.append(a[i])
        b.reverse()
    
    print(' '.join(map(str, b)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
